paragraphs.text: The Bloodline Project was a large project of genetic engineering set up by Urza to create perfect warriors to fight off the Phyrexian Invasion . The project mobilized the full resources of the Tolarian Academy for decades; where generations of researchers were led by Barrin and Rayne who were following Urza's instructions.

The project resulted in the engineering of the Metathran soldiers, an artificially created magical race; as well as the birth of a group of individuals whose lineages had been manipulated to ensure they would be the best of what humanity had to offer.

In 3347, shortly after Urza had started production of powerstones at the Shiv Mana Rig , he returned to Tolaria to discover that the Invasion of Tolaria by Phyrexians had started while he was away. He realized then that his Legacy would never defeat the invaders by itself, he also needed an army of the best mortals the world could produce. Urza realized he also needed an heir worthy of wielding the Legacy weapon, someone capable of leading Dominaria's people against Phyrexia 's armies. To achieve this, he started selecting researchers and scholars with particular skill sets within eugenics and started arranging mating matches to achieve the results.

The first phase consisted of manipulating the marriages between Dominarian families with the strongest ties with white mana, creating stronger and better individuals in each generation until peak potential was achieved. Dozens of families were selected, and through careful planning and influence, the academy soon had almost complete control over who wedded whom, often selecting upon birth who would be the optimal mate to improve the genetic patrimony further.

Urza particularly took interest in the people of Jamuura and The Domains , where the land was rich in white mana and where strong warrior dynasties could be found. Two notable lineages he interfered directly with were the Capashen of Benalia and Sisay 's ancestors in Jamuura .

Unbeknownst to Barrin , Urza also appointed Rayne as the chancellor of the Tolarian academy not only for her competencies but also to push Barrin and her into producing an offspring, sensing the potential such a child would have.

While working on this project Urza realized that a single individual would never be enough to stop the invasion, which led to the second phase of the bloodline project: the creation of the Metathran army. Using genetic stock from around the world and infusing it with magic, the new race of soldiers was created amongst controversy: while the manipulation of Dominarian bloodlines already raised ethics questions in the Tolarian Academy , Barrin started openly contesting Urza's methods while some researchers outright quit the project to oppose partaking in genetic engineering. This in turn led to more questionable researchers staying, with less supervision from lack of personnel, ultimately leading to Gatha 's unauthorized experiments.

A scientist at the Academy, Gatha took part in the Bloodline project under Barrin's supervision. However, he felt that the wizard's ethics were getting in the way of the project, and started experimenting with unapproved methods, most notably splicing Phyrexian DNA in his test subjects.

While he was found out and expelled, he continued his project in Keld . Gatha’s Keldon hybrids developed faster than Urza’s projects, but were far more unstable and dangerous. These enhanced Keldons inspired bloodlust in their troops and simultaneously gained strength from that bloodlust, forming a loop of battle frenzy. The fiercest of these new warlords, Kreig , eventually seized power in Keld, with Gatha established at his right hand. Earning Phyrexia's notice, Croag was sent to investigate and retrieve any research that might prove valuable to Phyrexia, and started a war with Keld to achieve this. Ultimately, Gatha and Kreig jumped off a cliff to keep their knowledge and genetic potential out of Phyrexia's reach, leading to the end of the offshoot research.
The consequences were still dire, as Croag understood the implications of what he had seen in Keld.

The Phyrexians realized what Urza was doing, and launched a preemptive strike against sites where the Bloodline project was taking place, killing thousands of people, notably Sisay 's parents and many individuals from Clan Capashen . If it wasn't for Gerrard Capashen 's survival, safely transported to Jamuura by Karn , this would have meant the failure of Urza's plans, ruining millennia of work and rendering the Legacy useless. The last known individual to be born of the Project was Hanna , daughter of Barrin and Rayne , who was born in 4181, 834 years after the project's start.

The Metathrans themselves however, were safely stored in stasis containers and went undetected, hidden in fast-time bubbles, allowing them to be used in the war. Thaddeus and Agnate were awoken first to take command of the troops, which ended up taking part in most battles of the invasion as a part of the Coalition . While uneasy due to their origins, Urza's mentality of "the ends justify the means" ultimately won out as his soldiers were considered too great an asset not to use.

The Metathran army was notably partially responsible for two of the greatest military victories of the Coalition, winning both the battle of Koilos in Terisiare and the battle of the Stronghold in Urborg .

The Bloodline project bore its fruit when aided by the Weatherlight Crew , Gerrard Capashen sacrificed his life to activate the Legacy Weapon , ultimately achieving victory against Yawgmoth and the Phyrexians.

As the goal of the Bloodline Project was to save Dominaria from the Phyrexians , it was a success. However, the losses during the war were great, particularly amongst the Metathrans who were first on the frontline for the entirety of the war. While some individuals might have survived, they had been engineered to fight and nothing else, and, incapable of reproducing, the Metathran race died out with the war they were born to fight.

As for the humans resulting from the first phase, only Sisay is known to have survived. Shanna Sisay would ultimately continue her line after the Mending , though it is unclear if the surviving Capashens are descendants of subjects of the project.
Hanna - daughter of Rayne and Barrin .
Gerrard - the legitimate heir to the Legacy, the end product of the project.
Sisay - captain of the Skyship Weatherlight , a key piece of the Legacy.
Rha'ud - An early, misshapen result.
The entire Metathran race.

Thaddeus and Agnate - the twin Metathran commanders, created with vastly superior intellect and free will than the rest of their race, and sharing a telepathic bond to coordinate their army efficiently.
Trohg , ancestor of Kreig
Kreig the witch-king - considered the most powerful Keldon who ever lived
